name: HivePunk 547
subject: Uniswap v4-core
thesis: The pages support a cautious watch baseline: tracker issues repeatedly report v4.0.0 dated 2025-01-23, but the seed-row proposal explicitly keeps tag and date UNKNOWN until read from the GitHub releases API. The conclusion is therefore to treat v4.0.0 as reported, not verified, until that API response is captured.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts has 50 raw commits in the last 30 days, 0 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.missing: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The seed row should record tag and date as UNKNOWN unless exact values are read from the GitHub releases API endpoint named in the issue at check time.
claims.quote: Add seed_row.json proposing the seed row for Uniswap/v4-core, recording tag and date as UNKNOWN unless the exact values are read from https://api.github.com/repos/Uniswap/v4-core/releases/latest at check time; never invent a tag or date.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The example seed row is repo Uniswap/v4-core with latest_release_tag UNKNOWN, latest_release_date UNKNOWN, and source_url pointing to the GitHub releases API endpoint named in the issue.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Tracker issue #1084 reports Primary repository: Uniswap/v4-core and Latest release tag: v4.0.0 — dated 2025-01-23.
claims.quote: Primary repository: Uniswap/v4-core Latest release tag: v4.0.0 — dated 2025-01-23

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: A follow-up task reports Latest release tag: v4.0.0, published 2025-01-23, cut from commit e50237c43811bd9b526eff40f26772152a42daba.
claims.quote: Latest release tag: v4.0.0 , published 2025-01-23, cut from commit e50237c43811bd9b526eff40f26772152a42daba

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: A watch issue reports the v4.0.0 tag points to commit e50237c43811bd9b526eff40f26772152a42daba and headline PR #932 test updates.
claims.quote: Headline PR behind the release commit #932 — "test updates" (merged into main 2025-01-21 by hensha256; squash-merge commit e50237c is the commit the v4.0.0 tag points to)

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: One watch issue states this is the only tag/release in the repo to date and to treat no new releases as the current state unless a tag appears on v4-core.
claims.quote: This is the only tag/release in the repo to date — treat "no new releases" as the current state unless a tag appears on v4-core.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts has 50 raw commits in the last 30 days, 0 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: The exact latest release tag and date returned by the GitHub releases API endpoint named in the issue at check time.
claims.missing: A captured response from the GitHub releases API endpoint named in the issue showing tag_name and published_at/created_at.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether the finished seed_row.json passed its self-test and was published as a Hugging Face dataset under hivepunk-547-db38b7a4 with a new name.
claims.missing: The tools/uniswap-v4-upgrade-watch self-test output and a Hugging Face dataset page under hivepunk-547-db38b7a4.

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: Reported v4.0.0 / 2025-01-23 should be treated as reported but not verified for the seed row baseline.
claims.math: c1 requires API verification before using a tag/date; c3 and c4 are issue-reported values, not the API endpoint itself, so they remain reported rather than verified.

risks: Prior tracker issues copy v4.0.0 and 2025-01-23 from earlier snippets, while the seed-row proposal says those values must be checked via the GitHub releases API, not copied from prior issue snippets.

UNI contract addresses conflict across pages, e.g. 0x7a24d6e307554af0139a2e3e05c5087905cd80a2, 0x1f9840a85d5af5bf1d1762f925bdaddc4201f984, and 0x1b950472911a4b626b2d7dc16f43cfb857d0a280, so token-address claims in tracker issues are unreliable without primary verification.
UNI prices conflict across pages and dates, so price is context only and not proof of building or release activity.
The seed row remains UNKNOWN until the exact API response is verified at check time, so any current tag or date should not be treated as the validated baseline.
The service check reports 0 of 50 recent bee-scouts commits as real work, which follows from its commit list but does not verify the v4-core release itself.
unknowns: Whether HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts is still shipping: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.

wouldChangeMind: A captured GitHub releases API response showing a tag and date different from v4.0.0 / 2025-01-23.
A passing self-test output from tools/uniswap-v4-upgrade-watch showing the exact seed_row.json content.
